slug: 良膳小娘子下-子纹-面对偏心偏到天边去的家人赵小丫这世学聪明了-被当奴婢使唤嫁给傻子换银子的烂事绝不会再发生-娘亲与姊姊
lines: 第十一章 大年夜挥鞭制裁(1)
大年三十，在兴善寺带发修行的周堂尧一早便已返家。
老夫人以年纪大，不爱荤腥为由，围炉吃团圆饭时也跟着周堂尧茹素。
其他人见了，自然也说为了给老夫人和侯爷积福，要跟着茹素，最后演变成十六道大菜，八素、八荤，荤菜硬是没人敢动。
一场团圆饭吃得面上其乐融融，家宴过后，奴才上来收拾，撤了圆桌，各主子坐在厅堂中，面前都放上茶。
老夫人喝了口茶，露出慈爱的笑，对周堂尧说：“这可是伯延特地寻来的毛尖，味道极好，就等着你今日回来给你尝尝。”
周堂尧闻言喝了一口，点了点头。
他并非老夫人所出，老夫人是继妻，虽顶了个正妻之位，但毕竟只是续弦，两人之间的关系淡淡。
这些年周堂尧造桥铺路、施衣济寒，最后犹觉不足，竟动了变卖数代累积的家产良田、铺子的念头，这些年陆续卖出，只为兴建寺庙。
老夫人想要阻止，偏偏一道圣旨至昆阳侯府，圣上大赞侯爷心善，御赐积善余庆的匾额，如今高挂堂上，与先皇御赐侯府先祖的忠勇节义匾额互相辉映。
圣上赞许，老夫人再不满也只能吞下去，甚至还得咬着牙支持。
想到那花出去的白花花的银两，她的心就一抽一抽的疼。
穿着一身素白的周屹天在众人惊讶的目光底下姗姗来迟。
老夫人眉头轻皱了下，她年纪大了，忌惮的事越多，平时就不喜看着晚辈一身素净，像家中有白事一般，更别提如今还是过年过节。
周屹天的目光淡淡扫过，最终站到了二房叔父面前。
周军向的身子微僵了下，而后好脾气的笑笑，让出了位子。
周屹天不客气的在最靠近首位之处坐了下来。
老夫人抿了下唇，看着众人因他到来，全换了位子，原还想端着样子问是否用了膳，话却硬生生的卡在嘴里，这个孽障就是惹人嫌的主。
“怎么来得如此迟？”老夫人心中不快，口气也不善了起来。
在侯府，周屹天向来是个外人，幼学之年在国子监动手打了当时还是太子的当今圣上和恭亲王世子，可谓一战成名。
虽事后皇室以孩子打闹为由不予追究，但老夫人气急，拿了家法伺候，却没碰到周屹天一根寒毛，反而被他给一脚踢倒在地。
周堂尧立刻被从寺庙请回府，以一句闭门思过将人送到了城外的庄子——这一送，周屹天形同被逐出侯府。
众人皆知那庄子是周屹天的短命娘留下的嫁妆，至此之后，周堂尧醉心佛法，以寺为一家，唯一骨血又不在，没了“外人”，老夫人与二房自然过得舒心，只是没料到鲜少踏足侯府的周屹天竟然会在大年夜再入侯府大门，偏偏碍于他是侯爷嫡子，众人还是得要敬着。
周屹天看着下人上茶，神情淡淡，彷佛没听到老夫人的问话。
老夫人眉头一皱，看向坐在一旁的周堂尧，就见他彷佛瞎了眼似的，依然微眯着眼，转着佛珠，不发一言。
老夫人心中暗骂，在她眼中看来，这对父子毫无能耐，偏偏还厚着脸皮占着侯府主人的位置。
“老二媳妇。”老夫人生硬的问道：“你是怎么当家的？怎么让大爷在过年过节穿得一身素雅？”
听到老夫人的问话，侯府二房媳妇柳氏知道老夫人想要藉机发作，连忙起身回道：“虽说府里的银钱吃紧……”她暗暗的看了周堂尧一眼，谁知人家老僧入定，连个眼神都没给，她心中暗咒，想要周堂尧良心发现，兴许得等天下红雨才成。
“但媳妇早早便请绣娘做了几套新衣，媳妇也不知大爷为何今日……”话声隐去，倒带了丝委屈和无奈。
柳氏手握昆阳侯府中馈，府里内外近两百张嘴的嚼用都得经过她的手，虽说她打心里看不上周屹天这个娘亲早亡，有爹等于没爹的小子，但耐不住人家虽不是世子，却还是顶着侯爷摘子的名头，为了二房的好名声，她可不会蠢到在明面上短缺他什么。
老夫人闻言果断的沉下了脸，“怎么？屹天是瞧不上你婶母给你备的新衣不成？”
周屹天这才正眼看老夫人，冷淡回道：“确实瞧不上。婶母有那份心思每季多做几件衣裳，倒不如省下来给侯爷做善事，毕竟圣上节俭治国，纵是喜庆大节也不喜张扬，二房还是多做点善事，给自个儿积点阴德。”
柳氏身子微僵，心中暗骂，这个孽障！也不想想侯府上下要不是有她打点，如今可不知要败破成什么模样，竟然还拿当今圣上来压她，让她二房积阴德……真是欺人太甚！
她险些发作，但她最看重的长子先一步开口，“大哥说得在理，娘亲以后留心便是。”
柳氏闻言立刻挤出一点笑，对周屹天说道：“婶母以后会留意。”
周屹天的反应只是轻哼了声。
柳氏再难挂上笑容，抿起唇，看向老夫人。
老夫人眉头一皱，原想寻个由头将周屹天训斥一顿，却没想到反被周屹天给堵住了嘴，提到当今圣上……她挥了挥手，“算了，老二媳妇，坐下吧。”
柳氏称是坐下。
“大哥，难得见你回府，可用膳了？我让下人传膳。”周伯延面上挂着温和的笑容。
侯府二房长子周伯延，能文能武，广结京城才俊，进退有度，订亲礼部尚书嫡长女。
这门亲事二房确实高攀，但众人皆知，事情未必如此。
昆阳侯府世子之位空悬多年，明明周屹天才是周堂尧的嫡子，但周堂尧却迟迟未请旨。
京城隐隐有传闻，周堂尧担忧周屹天行事冲动狂妄，败坏侯府名声，想传贤不传子。
这些年见周伯延与周堂尧亲近，在众人心中俨然已是将来的昆阳侯，未来的昆阳侯与尚书嫡女自然是天作之合。
这门亲事早早定下，来年秋天便会成亲，众人是存心也是故意，无视与周伯延同年的周屹天其实还未有婚配一事。
“免了！”周屹天解开身上的白狐裘，手臂轻松一转，原本缠在手臂上的九节鞭稳稳握在掌中。
这条九节鞭重达十二斤，但在周屹天手中却轻如薄纸。
看到灯光下散发着冷光的九节鞭，众人神情倶变，就连周堂尧转动佛珠的手都顿住。
“大胆！”先回过神来的老夫人斥道。
这条九节鞭是当年侯府祖上开国有功，先皇御赐，平时挂于侯府祠堂上，上次动用还是周屹天十岁那年与皇子打群架，可是最终也没有动到周屹天分毫。
“确实大胆。”周屹天冷冷的勾了下唇角，眼底闪过寒光，“昆阳侯府三爷出入赌坊，闲言闲语早在京城流传，侯府颜面荡然无存。”
赌坊？老夫人虽深居内宅，但也不是双耳不闻窗外事，她自然知道二房次子周仲醖流连赌坊，她问过几次，都被柳氏以小孩子玩乐为由打发，如今周屹天咬出此事，可见事实并非如柳氏所言简单。
她眸光锐利的扫向柳氏和明显带着心虚的周仲醖。
柳氏心中隐隐不安，畏惧的看着周屹天手中的九节鞭，“瞧大爷说的，不过是小孩子家家爱玩罢了。”
论起看重，柳氏心中最在意的自然是长子周伯延，自小懂事聪慧，样样不需操心，而么儿却是个不省心的主。
“好个年纪尚幼，想当初老夫人请出九节鞭，我也不过十岁，那时我倒是够年长了。”

Chapter 11 Whiplash and Sanctions on New Year’s Eve (1)
On New Year's Eve, Zhou Tangyao, who led the spiritual practice at Xingshan Temple, returned home early in the morning.
The old lady followed Zhou Tangyao and became a vegetarian during the reunion dinner around the fire on the grounds that she was old and did not like meat.
When other people saw it, they naturally said that in order to bring good fortune to the old lady and the Marquis, they would follow the vegetarian diet, which eventually evolved into sixteen dishes, eight vegetarian and eight meat. No one dared to touch the meat dishes.
It was a happy reunion dinner. After the family banquet, the servants came up to clean up, removed the round table, and the masters sat in the hall, with tea in front of them.
The old lady took a sip of tea, showed a loving smile, and said to Zhou Tangyao: "This is the hair tip that Boyan specially found. It tastes very good. I'm just waiting for you to come back today to try it."
Zhou Tangyao took a sip after hearing this and nodded.
He is not the daughter of the old lady. The old lady is her stepwife. Although she has assumed the position of the head wife, after all, she is just a continuation of the relationship, and the relationship between the two is weak.
Over the years, Zhou Tangyao built bridges, paved roads, and provided clothing to help the poor. In the end, he felt that it was not enough, and he even thought about selling off the farmland and shops that had been accumulated for generations. He sold them one after another over the years just to build temples.
The old lady wanted to stop him, but an imperial edict was sent to the Kunyang Hou Mansion. The Holy Lord praised the Marquis for his kindness, and the plaque that he bestowed upon him for his good deeds is now hanging high in the hall, complementing the plaque of the late emperor's gift for the loyalty, bravery, and righteousness of the ancestors of the Hou Mansion.
The Holy Lord approved, but no matter how dissatisfied the old lady was, she could only swallow it, and she even had to grit her teeth to support it.
Thinking of the money spent, her heart ached.
Zhou Yitian, dressed in plain white, arrived late under the surprised eyes of everyone.
The old lady frowned slightly. As she got older, she had more things to worry about. She usually didn't like to see her juniors dressed so plainly, as if there were some white things in the family, let alone the New Year and the holidays.
Zhou Yitian's eyes swept over him lightly, and finally he stood in front of his second uncle.
Zhou Junxiang's body stiffened slightly, then he smiled good-naturedly and gave up his seat.
Zhou Yitian unceremoniously sat down near the first place.
The old lady pursed her lower lip and watched everyone change their seats because of his arrival. She wanted to ask if she had eaten, but the words stuck in her mouth. This evil person was the one who made people dislike her.
"Why are you here so late?" The old lady was unhappy and her tone was not good.
In the Hou Mansion, Zhou Yitian has always been an outsider. When he was a child in the Imperial Academy, he beat the current prince Shengshang and Prince Gong, who was still the prince at the time. He became famous in one battle.
Although the royal family refused to pursue the case after the incident because the children were playing, the old lady was so angry that she took advantage of the family's methods. However, Zhou Yitian didn't even touch her, and instead she was kicked to the ground by him.
Zhou Tangyao was immediately invited back to his home from the temple, and was sent to Zhuangzi outside the city with a sentence of shutting up and thinking about his past mistakes. This sending was like being expelled from the Hou Mansion.
Everyone knew that Zhuangzi was the dowry left by Zhou Yitian's short-lived mother. After that, Zhou Tangyao became obsessed with Buddhism and regarded the temple as a family. The only flesh and blood was gone. Without the "outsider", the old lady and the second wife naturally lived comfortably. However, they did not expect that Zhou Yitian, who rarely set foot in the Hou's mansion, would actually enter the Hou's mansion again on New Year's Eve. However, because he was the Hou's legitimate son, everyone still had to respect him.
Zhou Yitian looked at the servants serving tea with a calm expression, as if he had not heard the old lady's question.
The old lady frowned and looked at Zhou Tangyao who was sitting beside her. She saw that he seemed to be blind, still squinting his eyes slightly and turning his beads without saying a word.
The old lady cursed in her heart. In her eyes, the father and son were incompetent, yet they still shamelessly occupied the position of the master of the Hou Mansion.
"Second daughter-in-law." The old lady asked stiffly: "How did you become the head of the family? How did you make the uncle dress elegantly during the New Year and the holidays?"
Hearing the old lady's question, Mrs. Liu, the second daughter-in-law of the Hou Mansion, knew that the old lady wanted to take the opportunity to have an attack, so she quickly stood up and replied: "Although the money in the house is tight..." She glanced at Zhou Tangyao secretly, but to her surprise, the old monk fell into meditation and didn't even look at him. She secretly cursed in her heart. If Zhou Tangyao's conscience was to find out, she might have to wait until it rains red.
"But my daughter-in-law asked the embroiderer to make a few sets of new clothes a long time ago. She doesn't know why the uncle today..." The words faded away, and there was a trace of grievance and helplessness.
Mrs. Liu holds the feeder in Kunyang Hou's residence, and nearly two hundred mouths inside and outside the residence have to pass through her hands. Although she can't bear to see Zhou Yitian, a boy whose mother died early and whose father means no father, she can't bear it. Although he is not the eldest son, he still takes the title of the Marquis' son picker. For the good reputation of the second wife, she will not be stupid enough to lack him in public.
The old lady's face darkened decisively when she heard this, "What? Yitian doesn't like the new clothes your aunt prepared for you?"
Only then did Zhou Yitian look at the old lady and replied coldly: "I really don't like it. If my aunt is willing to make a few more clothes every season, it would be better to save the money and do good deeds for the Marquis. After all, the Holy Father governs the country through frugality and does not like to show off even if it is a festive occasion. The second wife should do more good deeds to accumulate some virtue for herself."
Mrs. Liu stiffened slightly and cursed in her heart, this evil obstacle! I don’t even think about how the entire Hou family would be in ruins if she hadn’t been in charge of it. They even used the current saint to oppress her and let her second wife accumulate evil deeds... It’s really too much!
She almost had an attack, but her eldest son, whom she valued most, spoke first, "Eldest brother is right. Mother, please pay attention in the future."
Upon hearing this, Mrs. Liu immediately squeezed out a smile and said to Zhou Yitian, "Auntie will pay attention to it in the future."
Zhou Yitian's reaction was just a slight snort.
Mrs. Liu could no longer put on a smile, pursed her lips, and looked at the old lady.
The old lady frowned. She originally wanted to find a reason to scold Zhou Yitian, but she didn't expect to be silenced by Zhou Yitian. When she mentioned the current emperor...she waved her hand, "Forget it, second daughter-in-law, sit down."
Liu said sit down.
"Brother, it's rare to see you back home. Is there any food available? I'll ask my servants to pass on the food." Zhou Boyan had a gentle smile on his face.
Zhou Boyan, the eldest son of the second eldest son of the Hou family, was talented in literature and martial arts. He had many talents in the capital. He was well-controlled in advance and retreat. He was engaged to be the eldest daughter of the Minister of Etiquette.
This second marriage is indeed a high-profile affair, but everyone knows that this may not be the case.
The position of the crown prince of the Kunyang Hou Mansion had been vacant for many years. It was clear that Zhou Yi was the legitimate son of Zhou Tangyao, but Zhou Tangyao had not yet requested the imperial edict.
There are vague rumors in the capital that Zhou Tangyao is worried that Zhou Yitian will act impulsively and arrogantly, ruining the reputation of the Marquis House, and wants to pass down the virtuous people instead of to his descendants.
Seeing that Zhou Boyan and Zhou Tangyao were close over the years, everyone seemed to think that they were the future Marquis of Kunyang. The future Marquis of Kunyang and the official daughter of the Minister were naturally a match made in heaven.
The marriage was decided long ago, and they will get married in the next autumn. Everyone, intentionally or deliberately, ignored the fact that Zhou Yitian, who was the same year as Zhou Boyan, was not yet married.
"No need!" Zhou Yitian untied the white fox fur on his body, turned his arm easily, and held the nine-section whip that was originally wrapped around his arm firmly in his palm.
This nine-section whip weighs twelve kilograms, but in Zhou Yitian's hand it is as light as thin paper.
Seeing the nine-section whip emitting cold light under the light, everyone's expressions changed suddenly, and even Zhou Tangyao's hand that turned the beads stopped.
"Bold!" scolded the old lady who came to her senses first.
This nine-section whip was given by the late emperor to the ancestors of the Hou Mansion for their contribution to the founding of the country. It is usually hung in the ancestral hall of the Hou Mansion. The last time it was used was when Zhou Yitian was ten years old when he had a group fight with the prince, but in the end it did not touch Zhou Yitian at all.
"You are indeed bold." Zhou Yitian raised the corners of his lips coldly, and a cold light flashed in his eyes, "The third master of the Kunyang Hou Mansion went in and out of the gambling house. Gossips have been circulating in the capital for a long time, and the face of the Hou Mansion has been completely wiped out."
Gambling house? Although the old lady lived deep in the inner house, she was not blind to what was going on outside the window. She naturally knew that the second son of the second wife, Zhou Zhongying, was hanging out in the gambling house. She asked several times, but Ms. Liu dismissed her on the grounds that she was a child. Now that Zhou Yitian has revealed this, it can be seen that the truth is not as simple as Mr. Liu said.
She glanced sharply at Mrs. Liu and Zhou Zhongling, who was obviously guilty.
Mrs. Liu felt a little uneasy in her heart and looked at the nine-section whip in Zhou Yitian's hand with fear, "Look what the uncle said, it's just children who like to play."
When it comes to things that matter to her, the one she cares most about is her eldest son Zhou Boyan, who has been sensible and intelligent since he was a child and doesn't need to worry about anything, but Mo'er is a carefree master.
"A lot of them are still young. I think when the old lady asked for the nine-section whip, I was only ten years old. I was old enough at that time."
